newsitem.title: UK: European cotton trade subdued, awaiting New York.
newsitem.headline: European cotton trade subdued, awaiting New York.

text.p: European trade in raw cotton was limited on Monday as the market awaited some indication of price direction from New York futures, industry sources said.
There were reports of fresh trades in Turkish Adana roller-ginned styles and long-stapled Egyptian types but only in small volumes, they said.
Central Asian cottons continue to attract mill-buyers seeking to cover their requirements for top-quality upland types in the face of uncertain supply.
